profile.name: Manoj Kandpal
profile.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building enterprise-scale web applications end to end — from JavaScript/TypeScript frontends (React, Nuxt.js, Vue) to Java and Spring Boot microservices on Azure. Skilled in REST API design, relational and NoSQL databases, Git-based CI/CD workflows, and automated testing, with a track record of performance optimization, code reviews, and Agile/Scrum delivery at scale.

highlights: Design and build new Java and Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs for feature rollouts, integrated with the Next.js frontend on Azure, optimizing data serialization and caching to improve UI responsiveness.
Migrated legacy Spring Boot 2.x microservices to modern releases, enhancing security posture, startup speed, and API reliability.
Created reusable Sitecore CMS components with Vanilla JavaScript and built Nuxt.js enterprise web apps used by 10,000+ daily global users.
Modernized Maersk.com's Integrated Global Navigation frontend, delivering a highly scalable and intuitive UI.
Lead the Ask Maersk AI Web Component, maintaining a 30–35% CTR while consistently lowering support case creation.
Participate actively in daily Scrum sprints, performing peer code reviews and mentoring team members.
Designed and executed targeted A/B experiments to optimize user workflows, driving a 10–15% boost in overall engagement.
Implemented behavioral analytics by instrumenting GTM dataLayer events and building dashboards to map user traffic.

Worked as a full stack developer on the core Case Management platform — built and maintained backend microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Azure cloud-native architectures, and developed the Next.js frontend.
Participated actively in Agile/Scrum processes including sprint planning, estimation, retrospectives, and daily pull request code reviews using Git.
Optimized frontend and backend performance across legacy modules to improve UI responsiveness and API efficiency.
Deployed semantic, SEO-friendly frontend architecture across production pages to maximize search engine discoverability.
Migrated manual testing to Cypress, reducing regression testing efforts by 80–90%.
